items.q: Well, now, I've left -- I went with Billy Fowler's band.

ctx.x: Oh, there's one thing I wanted to clear up, you told me at the bar one time. You told me about a time when -- well, we'll talk about "Paris Blues" later. This is a story you told me about Ellington.
